standalone_cli: continue_gamma.py --pi COMPLETE_PI_CATALOG --mean ACTUAL_M2_RESULT --previous ACTUAL_G1_PROVIDER --output NEW_DIRECTORY --binary ADMITTED_A85_BINARY [--order 1] [--beta 1] [--timeout 900] [--resume]

inputs.pi: 0089.pi_history.PiKernels; complete-gamma-pi only, all greater/lesser/retarded complex128[31,31,114,114]. No Sigma prerequisite or zeros.
inputs.mean: 0086.dressed_mean.DressedMean; persisted raw G1 forcing, original full-phase preparation ancestry and exact all31 source.
inputs.previous: 0063.history_provider.PreviousHistory with actual provider, not bare/legacy/control data. Actual provider identity is distinct from its original numerical reference and original preparation.
inputs.preparation: Literal original electron rho0 and full114 Gamma0, exact integer N64, all31 grid, order1/beta1; unchanged A63 solve_gamma_slot checks original Gamma0 again.
inputs.binary: Actual supplied binary bytes/SHA must match admitted 0085/verification-001.json production_binary. Actual path binding is retained; byte-identical copied executable is not relabeled.

implementation.solve: Unchanged 0063.continue_history.solve_gamma_slot and 0061.production_transport.FinalBank; exactly one full114 slot, finalized only after its durable commit.
implementation.readout: Reopen actual saved complete bank via A61 load_solution, use unchanged owning history_readout.gamma_readout/json_value for raw canonical Ni1/x q0 probe with 1/sqrt(N) normalization. Retain complex initial/final variance, initial preparation defect, equal-time covariance Hermitian defect, two-time lesser anti-Hermitian defect and raw differences from G1. No clipping, Hermitization or calibrated-loss interpretation.
implementation.recovery: Explicit resume requires identical invocation/source/binary/order/beta/timeout. Only committed slots skip science. Retained uncommitted staging/allocation is refused; no auto retry or in-Native resume promise.
implementation.costs: Persist running/failed/complete attempt receipts, owner wall/maxRSS, retained Native wall/CPU/maxRSS and unknown interrupted costs. Actual upstream Pi/family/manager/M2/G1/binary/recovery source artifacts remain bound, not reset or counted zero. Overlapping wall measures are not additive.

typed_result.reader: GammaResult(result_path), context manager; .binding, .spec, .complete, .solution, .bindings; close() ends mapped-array lifetime.
typed_result.reuse_validation: GammaResult.validate(kernels, mean, previous, *, binary, verification, order, beta) -> self. Supply the actual complete fullcatalog OwnedKernels for later full continuation. Before electronic Native, authenticate result/invocation/readout/cost/source bindings and complete-bank/slot/native receipts, exact M2/G1/preparation/N/grid/order/beta and admitted binary. All three Pi NPY shape/dtype/bytes/SHA must match exactly; only paths may differ after canonical composition. No tolerance, changed-input acceptance or relabeling. Original source/kernel R/< payload digests are also checked.
typed_result.no_circular_import: gamma_result imports neither continuation driver. Standalone and full drivers consume its reader directly.

full_reuse.behavior: Validate before electronic Native; open/run only the local electron bank, never allocate/refill/copy/rerun Gamma. Provider gamma.complete points at the exact external complete binding. Public SavedHistory/readout genuinely joins all128 new electron slots and that exact new Gamma. Omitting the option retains fresh local Gamma and committed-slot/refused-staging behavior.
full_reuse.provenance: Union current full solve sources with precomputed Gamma/result/bank/source bindings, preserving all actual paths. Invocation/provider/result/handoff identify precomputed origin. Local Native counts mean new calls only (up to128 electrons with reuse, not129); costs retain the precomputed Gamma original accounting/receipts separately rather than summing overlapping or upstream work.

verification: Root executed actual Pi[G1]+M2 Gamma continuation, original raw saved readout and GammaResult reader: actual-Gamma-block-observation.json. actual-Gamma-result-reuse-observation.json accepted actual original inputs and byte-identical Pi at different paths; rejected changed M2/G1/binary, actual changed Pi files and altered mapped solve payload. The later full-driver electronic join is intentionally unexecuted until actual complete Sigma/all128 new electronic histories exist; no fake complete dataset was substituted.
nonclaims: Not full G2 until actual complete Sigma and all128 new electronic histories exist and the joined readout is consumed.
